overview: Ghar Ka Kaam is a modern home services marketplace connecting homeowners with skilled construction laborers and domestic maid services. Homeowners can post jobs, browse worker profiles, and directly hire maids (cooks, cleaners, childcare, laundry) — all with secure messaging and milestone payments.
features: Browse and hire skilled construction workers (masons, carpenters, painters, electricians, plumbers)
Dedicated Maid Services section — browse cooks, house cleaners, laundry, childcare, and babysitters
Direct hire model — no bidding, just browse profiles and message to book
Job posting for homeowners with simple form (work type, location, budget, timeline)
Stripe-powered milestone payments — 50% upfront, 50% on completion
Thread-based messaging between homeowners and workers/maids
Ratings and reviews after job completion
Mobile-first responsive design with construction-themed colors
